description: Source code for error handling hooks in Zephyr RTOS test suite, including fatal error and assert failure hooks with conditional compilation for user space and SMP safety.

methods.name: reset_stored_fault_status
methods.description: Resets fault tracking variables to default state.

methods.name: z_impl_ztest_set_fault_valid
methods.description: Sets the fault validity flag and records current thread if valid.

methods.name: z_vrfy_ztest_set_fault_valid
methods.description: Verification wrapper for ztest_set_fault_valid, used in syscall context.

methods.name: k_sys_fatal_error_handler
methods.description: Handles fatal system errors, distinguishes expected vs unexpected errors.

methods.name: reset_stored_assert_status
methods.description: Resets assert tracking variables to default state.

methods.name: z_impl_ztest_set_assert_valid
methods.description: Sets the assert validity flag and records current thread if valid.

methods.name: z_vrfy_ztest_set_assert_valid
methods.description: Verification wrapper for ztest_set_assert_valid, used in syscall context.

methods.name: ztest_post_assert_fail_hook
methods.description: Hook called after an expected assert failure, aborts current thread.

methods.name: assert_post_action
methods.description: Handles actions after an assert failure, terminates thread or triggers panic.
